meta.title: Session remover
meta.description: Deletes a session permanently instead of archiving it, and cannot be undone. Open the "..." menu at the end of a session row in the sidebar and choose "Delete permanently...", then confirm in the dialog: the session's stored messages, any subagent sessions it started, its cached title and metadata, and its sidebar, archive, and pin entries are removed. A session open in a window must be closed first (nothing is deleted then). Attachment files the session referenced are kept. The agent can run the same operation through the session_delete tool.
